description: Accepts a Sergio suggestion card, as the card's accept does. action "accept" commits it as a task (optionally with your edited title, details or due, ISO 8601 or null); "accept_no_task" resolves it without a task when the work already happened. A card whose move would send a message, move money, open to the public or grant access is refused with where the owner does it; draft instead (create_draft, or run_suggestion_now on a draft card). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first answer.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: accept_suggestion
title: Accept a Sergio suggestion
